verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents taint tracking through dedicated taint rules for injection bugs such as XSS. It also documents cross-file (interfile) analysis for detecting vulnerabilities across files and folders, and interprocedural, interfile propagation on the AppSec Platform. Together these cover the core of cross-file, cross-function taint detection, though the evidence never states outright that taint flows are tracked across both boundaries. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or example of taint flows crossing files and functions, independent or hands-on corroboration of interfile taint accuracy, and clarity on whether this needs a paid AppSec Platform tier versus the open-source CLI.
